description: Fibularis Brevis hugs the outer calf, bracing the lateral ankle and flicking the little-toe edge of the foot for lively balance cues.
actions: Everts the foot, rolling weight toward the lateral border during agile steps and skater poses.
Assists plantarflexion at the ankle so the outer calf can press the foot downward in pointed gestures.
Stabilizes the base of the fifth metatarsal, partnering with fibularis longus to prevent ankle roll-ins.
